name: @vyaz/converters
description: Convert a formatted-HTML fragment or Markdown into a @vyaz/core TextFrame — inline formatting, lists, tables (colspan/rowspan, nested tables), images/SVG as inline boxes, clickable links.

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --target bun --external @vyaz/core --external @vyaz/renderer --external marked && bun build ./src/index.browser.ts --outdir ./dist --outfile ./dist/index.browser.js --target browser --external @vyaz/core --external @vyaz/renderer --external marked && tsc -b
